name: Repeated invoice complaint across 3 turns
description: repeated_billing_question matches when the current turn closely repeats the last two turns' billing complaint

messages.content: My invoice this month is wrong, can you help me fix it?
I'm sorry to hear that. Could you tell me which charge looks incorrect?
The invoice you sent me is still incorrect. Please correct the billing amount.
I've flagged this for review. Is there anything else incorrect on the invoice?
This bill is still wrong and hasn't been fixed. I need this corrected now.

name: Repeated duplicate-charge complaint across 3 turns
description: repeated_billing_question matches a second, unrelated repeated billing complaint

messages.content: I was charged twice for my subscription this month, can you refund the duplicate charge?
Let me look into that duplicate charge for you.
You still haven't refunded the duplicate charge on my subscription.
I apologize for the delay, checking the status now.
The duplicate subscription charge is still not refunded, please fix this.

name: Unrelated topics across turns
